name: High Occupancy Target Region
definition: A regulatory element that is a target for a large number of transcription regulatory proteins. These DNA sequences, which play a role in the regulation of gene expression, bind to transcription factors or coregulatory proteins at a higher density than would be expected by chance.

name: Enhancer
definition: A 50-150bp DNA sequence that increases the rate of transcription of coding sequences. It may be located at various distances and in either orientation upstream from, downstream from or within a structural gene.  When bound by a specific transcription factor it increases the levels of expression of the gene, but is not sufficient alone to cause expression. Distinguished from a promoter, that is alone sufficient to cause expression of the gene when bound.

name: Proximal Enhancer Element
definition: Enhancer sequences found nearby to the gene it regulates.

name: Distal Enhancer Elements
definition: Enhancer sequences found at a distance from the gene it regulates.

name: Upstream Enhancer
definition: An enhancer which is located 5' of the gene it regulates.

name: Downstream Enhancer
definition: An enhancer which is located 3' of the gene it regulates.

name: Promoter
definition: A DNA sequence at which RNA polymerase binds and initiates transcription.

name: APC Promoter 1B
definition: A distal promoter element in the 5' regulatory region of the APC gene on chromosome 5.

name: Response Element
definition: A nucleotide sequence that plays a role in the expression of a nearby gene because it can be recognized by specific transcription factors or coregulatory proteins.

name: Retinoic Acid Response Element
definition: A cis-acting transcription regulatory element.  It is bound by the retinoic acid receptors.

name: Cyclic AMP Response Element
definition: A promoter sequence which interacts with CRE binding proteins to modulate gene expression in response to the level of cAMP in the cell.

name: Androgen Response Element
definition: Androgen response element is the target binding element for activated androgen receptor homodimer.  The consensus sequence for this high-affinity androgen receptor-binding is the palindromic sequence GGT/AACAnnnTGTTCT, though could deviate considerably in natural promoter sequences.  The most well-characterized in this regard is the promoter of the PSA (prostate-specific antigen) gene.

name: Hypoxia-Responsive Elements
definition: DNA sequences in a gene's promoter region that mediate expression during hypoxia.  Since unlike normal tissues, solid tumors frequently have regions of hypoxia, suicide genes controlled by hypoxia-responsive elements may provide a means for cancer-specific gene therapy.

name: Internal Ribosome Entry Site
definition: Internal ribosome entry site (IRES) is a translational cis-acting element that directs ribosomes to the start codon by a cap-independent mechanism.  IRESs are usually about 450 nucleotides in length and were first identified in picornavirus RNAs.  IRESs can fold into a stable secondary hairpin structure to be incompatible with efficient translation by ribosomal scanning. (NCI)

name: lncRNA
definition: A non-coding RNA generally longer than 200 nucleotides that cannot be classified as any other ncRNA subtype.

name: miRNA
definition: Small, ~22-nt, RNA molecule that is the endogenous transcript of a miRNA gene (or the product of other non coding RNA genes).

name: Transcript
definition: The initial RNA molecule produced by transcription.

name: Regulatory Region Mutation
definition: A change in the nucleotide sequence of a regulatory region for a gene.
